[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1921 census indexes Lily Agnes Glasgow, age 39 Years 7 Months, at 113 Cambridge Road, Willesden, Middlesex, England. The schedule calls her Lily A Glasgow and lists her as wife, a charwoman. An alternate indexed name is Lily A Shirley.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/63150/records/10423354 Ancestry, 1921 England Census: Lily Agnes Glasgow, RG 15/6463, ED 7, Sch 40, record 63150/10423354].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The census identifies this resident; earlier and later identities remain open.

== Biography ==
The 1921 census indexes Sarah G Shirley, age 19, at 113 Cambridge Road, Willesden, Middlesex, England. The schedule calls her Sarah G Shirley; the index also gives Sarah G Glasgow. The indexed relationship is inconsistent, so her relationship to the head is unresolved.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/63150/records/10423358 Ancestry, 1921 England Census: Sarah G Shirley, RG 15/6463, ED 7, Sch 40, record 63150/10423358].</ref>

== Research Notes ==

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The 1921 census indexes Hilda Shirley, age 17 Years 8 Months, at 113 Cambridge Road, Willesden, Middlesex, England. The schedule calls her Hilda Shirley; the index also gives Hilda Glasgow. The indexed relationship is inconsistent. A Hilda Shirley of similar age is listed at the Kilburn address of Thomas Henry Glasgow in 1911.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/63150/records/10423359 Ancestry, 1921 England Census: Hilda Shirley, RG 15/6463, ED 7, Sch 40, record 63150/10423359].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The census identifies this resident; earlier and later identities remain open.
